hero.headline: មីបឋម — made here, for everyday Cambodia.
hero.description: From Kampong Speu, our team is building an everyday instant noodle brand around local production, responsible work and steady improvement.
hero.imageAlt: Illustrative image of an instant noodle production line; not a photograph of the LM Manufacturing facility

intro.title: From Kampong Speu to tables across Cambodia.
intro.text: LM Manufacturing is growing its people, production and brand in Cambodia. We focus on the everyday work behind a dependable food business: clear processes, capable teams and products made for the market we know best.
intro.imageAlt: Illustrative image of a noodle production facility; not the company’s actual factory

productsDescription: មីបឋម is our Cambodian instant noodle brand for convenient everyday meals. As each product is officially approved, we will share its flavor, ingredients, packaging and product information here.
factoryText: Our factory, warehouse and support teams work together behind the daily operations of មីបឋម. See how our local manufacturing site is taking shape.
factoryImageAlt: Illustrative view of noodle production; not a company facility photograph

benefits.title: Responsibility first
